T.definition: Number of weeks in the planning horizon

K.definition: Number of promotional price levels excluding the regular price

M.definition: Number of lagged prices used in the demand model

L.definition: Maximum number of promotion weeks allowed in the horizon

S.definition: Required number of separating periods between promotions

q_k.definition: Allowed price ladder where q_0 is the regular price and q_1 to q_3 are promotional prices

c_t.definition: Unit procurement cost in each week

eta_current.definition: Exponent on current price in the demand model

eta_lag1.definition: Exponent on previous week's price in the demand model

eta_lag2.definition: Exponent on price from two weeks ago in the demand model

p_init.definition: Fixed pre-horizon prices used for lagged demand terms
